parameters.content:
## Check Holdings
Send one item per holding with `symbol`, `quantity` and optionally `cost` (per share).

You get one item per holding (value, day change, profit or loss against cost, weight, flags) and one summary item (`kind: summary`). Flags: `rsi_overbought`, `rsi_oversold`, `earnings_soon` and, on Pro, `large_insider_sale`.

A holding Stocklake cannot price comes back with `found: false` and an `error`; the others are still valued. Holdings in several currencies are totalled per currency (`by_currency`), not added together.
